---
title: "Day-to-day operations"
---

Use this section to keep an existing workstation aligned with the repository and its data recoverable.

- **[Apply configuration](install_configuration.qmd):** Run `make configure` to converge the workstation.
- **[Audit configuration](audit_configuration.qmd):** Run the focused unmanaged-package and manual-installation audit, and review its deliberately limited scope.
- **[Update configuration](update_configuration.qmd):** Run `make update` to refresh repository and software versions before reconfiguring and auditing.
- **[Backup data](backup.qmd):** Follow the daily Git and Nextcloud checks, run or verify the Vorta/Borg backup each week, and test recovery regularly. Backup destinations, credentials, and schedules require deliberate manual configuration.

Run the update workflow regularly and review its audit findings rather than allowing local package drift to accumulate. Keep backup media disconnected except while backing up, checking, or restoring data.
